{"consolidated_memory":"storage/blob/uploader.rs — partial upload issues (two separate occasions)

OCCASION 1: [2026-06-07]
- Problem: Partial upload in the uploader
- Trigger: Input list came in empty
- Repro: Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
- Signal: Final part never gets acknowledged
- Result: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 75 days running
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #3382 on branch fix/partial-upload-1

OCCASION 2: [2026-07-13]
- Problem: Partial upload in the uploader
- Trigger: Two requests raced on the same key
- Repro: Upload 40 MB fixture over throttled link
- Root cause: Listener registered but never removed
- Signal: Final part never gets acknowledged
- Result: p99 latency fell from 3.0 s to 728 ms
- Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #4974 on branch fix/partial-upload-2

Both issues occurred in the same corner of storage/blob/uploader.rs, allowing context to carry over. Both shared the same repro conditions and symptom (final part unacknowledged) but had distinct root causes and different measured outcomes."}
